data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-2: telemetry-emit.sh invoked for each event type (review_cycle, review_finding, resolver_outcome, arbiter_ruling, tool_finding)
- dd-3: --key/--link wiring establishes finding_event_id linkage
- dd-5: ≤500ms p95 latency (satisfied by subprocess.Popen fire-and-forget)

Depends on: task 0c1d-a7d5-80ea-4914

## Implementation Notes
Add `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/telemetry_emit_wrapper.py` exposing `emit_event(event_type, key=None, link=None, **payload_kwargs)`:
- Resolves telemetry-emit.sh via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/telemetry/telemetry-emit.sh
- subprocess.Popen([...], stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL, start_new_session=True) — fire-and-forget; no .wait(), no .communicate()
- Returns silently when script absent or OSError raised (fail-open contract)

Wire 5 call sites:
1. review_finding — runner.py after reviewer-findings.json finalized; --key dso-llm:<cycle>:<finding_index>
2. resolver_outcome — arbiter_processor.py process_rulings() per resolution; --link dso-llm:<cycle>:<finding_index>
3. arbiter_ruling — arbiter_processor.py per ruling; --link same
4. tool_finding — runner.py tool findings (lint/type/syntax); one emit per finding
5. review_cycle — runner.py at cycle close; reads review-cycle-usage.json for aggregate token totals

Stdlib only — subprocess + os. DSO_TELEMETRY_DISABLE env var as unit-test bypass.

Tests: test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py (4+ tests) + test_telemetry_integration.py (full flow).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Wrapper exists and is importable
  Verify: python -c 'from dso_ci_review.telemetry_emit_wrapper import emit_event; assert callable(emit_event)'
- [ ] test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py exists with ≥4 tests
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py && [ "$(grep -c '^def test_' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py)" -ge 4 ]
- [ ] Happy-path: emit_event invokes Popen with telemetry-emit.sh + --event-type
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py::test_emit_event_invokes_popen -x
- [ ] Fire-and-forget: emit_event returns without .wait()/.communicate()
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py::test_emit_event_fire_and_forget -x
- [ ] OSError tolerance: emit_event swallows silently
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py::test_emit_event_oserror_silent -x
- [ ] All 5 event types emitted during runner.main()
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_integration.py::test_all_five_event_types_emitted -x
- [ ] --key/--link linkage works
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_integration.py::test_key_link_linkage -x
- [ ] Latency proxy dd-5: 5 sequential emits <100ms
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_emit_wrapper.py::test_emit_event_latency_under_100ms -x
- [ ] Fail-open: review run with telemetry.endpoint unset returns exit 0
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_telemetry_integration.py::test_review_succeeds_with_no_endpoint -x
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD -- pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\+' | grep -qvE '^\+\+\+'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
data.title: Emit telemetry-emit.sh events (5 types) with --key/--link via subprocess.Popen wrapper
